Lua 5.4.9
Source: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz
SHA-256: 2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6

This directory contains the unmodified library sources and headers from the
release's src/ directory. The standalone interpreter and compiler (lua.c,
luac.c) and the Makefile are omitted. lua-sources.rsp lists the subset that
MarkEdit compiles: the core plus the base, coroutine, table, string, math and
utf8 libraries. The io, os, package and debug libraries are not built, so
plugins cannot touch the file system or start processes.
